promises.summary: Requiring 19% to 20% CAGR to achieve $2 billion revenue goal.
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
promises.quote: We need a compounded annual growth rate in the range of 19 %-20%.

promises.summary: Targets an aspirational EBIT margin in the 16% to 17% range
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
promises.quote: Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration.

not_checkable.summary: Expects one-time transaction expenses of approximately USD 50 million
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: Overall, we are expecting one-time expenses to the tune of approximately $50 million spread over three to four quarters.

not_checkable.summary: Net new deal adding over $125 million annually
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: So, from this deal perspective, this is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

not_checkable.summary: Aspiration to scale company revenue to $5 billion by FY31
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: Many of you have asked us in Earning Calls before, do we need additional verticals to scale to the aspiration of $5 billion that we have? By FY31, we get that as well at a nice scale.

not_checkable.summary: Target to have European business at 15% plus of revenues
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: We add to the European business, we live to our dream of having European business at 15% plus.

not_checkable.summary: Net Debt to EBITDA leverage expected to reduce to 1X by FY30
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting $2 billion annual revenue by March 2027
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

not_checkable.summary: Aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: Over the course of this intensive offsite, we not only charted our priorities and focus areas for FY27 but also assessed our progress towards our long-term aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31 and did intensive trainings on the AI side for our entire leadership.

not_checkable.summary: Effective Tax Rate for FY26 expected between 20% and 24%
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting $2 billion in revenue by end of FY27
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: We are making steady progress towards our aspiration of reaching $2 billion by end of FY27.

not_checkable.summary: Expecting 100 basis points EBIT margin improvement in FY26
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: But on an overall note, if we are looking at our current trajectory, we are looking at 100 basis point improvement in FY26 , and probably another 100 basis point in FY27.

not_checkable.summary: Effective tax rate for FY26 expected between 22.5% and 23.5%
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: As discussed in the previous quarter's earnings call, the effective tax rate for FY26 is likely to remain in the range of 22.5% to 23.5%.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting reaching $2 billion in revenue by end of FY27.
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: We remain committed to our goal of reaching 2 billion dollars by end of FY27.

not_checkable.summary: Expecting effective tax rate between 22.5% and 23.5% for the year.
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: We expect our overall effective tax rate for the year to remain in the range of 22.5% to 23.5% going forward.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting trading margin improvement of 200 to 300 basis points by FY27.
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: We have mentioned in the past that it needs to be improved by 200 -300 basis point by the time we reach FY27.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting Europe to account for 15% of revenue in 2-3 years.
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: or if we get a good scalable acquisition in geographies like Europe, where we have clearly said that we want to be 15% in revenue terms as we go ahead in the next 2-3 years, we'll look at that.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting reaching 2 billion dollars in revenue by end of FY27
not_checkable.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
not_checkable.quote: We remain committed to our goal of reaching 2 billion dollars by end of FY27 and are well on that trajectory.

not_checkable.summary: Targeting margin improvement of 200-300 basis points by FY27
not_checkable.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
not_checkable.quote: Net-net we are pretty much confident and we are pretty much on track in terms of delivering our aspirational target of improving our margins by 200-300 basis points as we hit the 2 billion dollar revenue target by FY27.

rejected.summary: Expects incremental transaction expenses of USD 25 to 30 million
rejected.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
rejected.quote: Over the next two quarters, we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million to be incurred towards the Nagarro transaction.

rejected.summary: Targeting $5 billion revenue over next 4 to 5 years
rejected.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
rejected.quote: And as we get to our $5 billion over the next 4-5 years, we should be at, you know, $100 million per quarter in every sub -vertical.
